Authoritative inventory

Advertising & Provider Info

Fixed inventory, contract-enforced pricing, and no pay-to-rank behavior.

Overview

We publish structured, location-specific industry guides and city resources designed to help users understand their options and connect with real providers serving their area.

Advertising on this platform is inventory-based, disclosed, and contract-enforced — not auction-driven, not pay-to-rank, and not cluttered with uncontrolled placements.

How placement works

This page explains the inventory that can be purchased across the platform. Live sponsor placements appear only on eligible city, guide, state, and vertical hub pages.

What you control

  • Your placement tier (shared or exclusive)
  • Your market scope (city, state, or full vertical)
  • Your lead destination once a user submits through the sponsor flow

What we control

  • The integrity of the educational content
  • The structure of the user journey
  • Placement rules, hierarchy rules, and conflict enforcement across the platform

Ad-slot placement by page type

These are the validated placement surfaces on the platform. Availability depends on page type and sponsorship tier. If a placement would violate an active contract or hierarchy rule, the build hard-fails.

City pages

  • top ad slot
  • middle ad slot
  • bottom ad slot

Guide pages

  • top ad slot
  • bottom ad slot

State pages (PI only)

  • top ad slot
  • middle ad slot

Vertical hub / home pages

  • hero placement

This page is documentation only. Live sponsor placements appear on eligible city, guide, state, and vertical hub pages.

Hero position rule (buyouts): For City Buyout and State Buyout (PI only), the top placement renders in a hero-style format rather than creating a new slot.

Shared placements: Shared placements are stacked and we do not state a hard cap on the number of shared sponsors.

Sponsorship tiers (monthly pricing + scope)

City — Shared Placement (Stacked) $2,500 / city

  • City page: Top placement + Middle + Bottom (3 placements)
  • Shared (stacked): multiple sponsors may appear in these positions
Sponsorship inquiry

City — Buyout (Exclusive) $5,000 / city

  • City page: Top placement + Middle + Bottom (3 placements)
  • Exclusive: only your brand appears in these positions (subject to contract hierarchy rules)
  • Top placement renders hero-style
Sponsorship inquiry

State Buyout (PI only) $30,000 / state

  • State hub: Top (hero position) + Middle (2 placements)
  • Cumulative coverage across all covered city pages in the state
  • Expansion right: You have the right to add additional cities within the same state upon request as we expand coverage (most states begin with at least two major metro areas). Added cities become part of the state buyout coverage under the same state contract, subject to hierarchy/conflict rules.
  • Top placement renders hero-style
Sponsorship inquiry

Vertical Pack (total website) Buyout $75,000

  • Includes vertical hub hero, plus eligible pages across the vertical (subject to contract hierarchy rules)
  • Includes hero-style sponsor visibility on eligible buyout surfaces and sponsor-directed lead flow through the platform’s CTA buttons and form path
Sponsorship inquiry

What buyout pages look like

On buyout pages, the top placement becomes a hero-style sponsor unit. The page’s CTA buttons remain in place and direct users into the sponsor lead flow.

Lead routing note: When a sponsor buyout is active, leads submitted through the sponsor form flow go to the sponsor.
